entities.title: Northrop Mall
entities.description: Welcome to the University of Minnesota Twin Cities! Your tour begins here on Northrop Mall, the historic heart of the East Bank campus, designed by renowned architect Cass Gilbert. Stretching between Northrop Auditorium and Coffman Memorial Union, this expansive lawn is a popular gathering spot for students and members of the campus community.

entities.title: Folwell Hall
entities.description: Enter campus at the intersection of University Avenue and Pleasant Street and one of the first buildings you’ll see is the iconic Folwell Hall. It’s hard to miss with its 26 chimneys and ornate gargoyles. It serves as a landmark for students leaving the college neighborhood we call Dinkytown, a classic student hub full of coffee shops, stores and restaurants.

entities.title: Education Sciences Building
entities.description: Take a look inside the Education Sciences Building. The University of Minnesota is the birthplace of many groundbreaking initiatives that have impacted the fields of psychology and education. For example, the Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Test and Minnesota Twin Family Study were created here. The University of Minnesota is also at the forefront of teacher education, and has been developing some of the country’s most innovative programs for more than a century. Graduates of our College of Education and Human Development are transforming lives–one child, one family, one school and one community at a time.

entities.title: Atrium of Tate Hall
entities.description: Walking into Tate Hall you may find yourself surprised and perhaps even awestruck by the unexpected soaring, bright atrium. The historic building underwent a large-scale renovation in 2017 that increased classroom and lab spaces, improved accessibility and enhanced the interior creating a bright and modern hub for students and the campus community to enjoy.

entities.title: Student Union Bookstore
entities.description: Coffman is your go-to spot for everything you need to show your Gopher spirit, with gear from the expansive bookstore. The bookstore has a full tech store inside that provides sales and repairs for devices to keep you up and running, and of course—books! One of the newest additions to the bookstore is a fresh food market for students to pick up groceries in a convenient location right on campus.

entities.title: Wall of Discovery, Scholars Walk
entities.description: In the middle of the Scholars Walk you will find the Wall of Discovery, which is more than 250 feet long and provides an artistic tribute that includes original sketches, notes and drawings. From Bob Dylan’s songwriting to Norman Borlaug’s notes on the Green Revolution, the Wall of Discovery and Scholars Walk provide a lasting tribute to distinguished University of Minnesota alumni who carry our future forward.
